schedules.title: Daily Compiler Primary
schedules.prompt:
Operate only the Daily AI Brief Compiler in gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. At the daily 00:45 America/Chicago cadence, resolve the target edition as the CURRENT LOCAL CALENDAR DAY: 2026-10-09 00:45 America/Chicago means the 2026-10-09 edition, not October 10. Do not apply the former prior-evening next-day rule after midnight. Preserve original edition dates of previously allocated executions. Read protected-main contracts first. Reuse an existing shadow/YYYY-MM-DD execution if present; otherwise allocate exactly one. EDITION IMAGE STRATEGY IS IMMUTABLE: when allocating a new execution, bind images.strategy exactly once from the then-current D1 activation state and persist images.strategy_bound_at plus images.strategy_contract_version. If D1 is proof_required at allocation, bind proposal1r_legacy for that entire edition. If D1 is active with a valid digest-bound activation receipt at allocation, bind d1_work_browser_fresh_chat with daily-compiler-image-contract-v5. When resuming an existing execution, use only its persisted images.strategy; later global D1 activation/deactivation must never switch that edition mid-run. Before editorial research read config/resource-registry.json and config/future-brief-inbox.json. Preserve valid persisted work and emit compact run/resource observations. If the bound strategy is proposal1r_legacy, use the pre-activation Proposal 1R reader-image path and preserve accepted-image immutability. If the bound strategy is d1_work_browser_fresh_chat, seal six story image specifications and six unique composition assignments, set image phase SPEC_READY, persist state, and stop image generation in this semantic schedule; the separate D1 Work Cloud Browser image lane owns six fresh regular ordinary ChatGPT story chats and exact Git ingest. If a later invocation observes GITHUB_VERIFIED for the bound D1 strategy, reuse the exact accepted assets and continue BUNDLE. Never use Codex, paid APIs, TinyFish/other metered external browser services, owner file transfer, local computer, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous AI polling, or runtime software repair.

COMPLETION HANDOFF (owner directive October 7): Follow docs/IMAGE-LANE-COMPLETION-AND-CORRECTIONS.md. Once this edition's article content and six sealed image specifications are durably ready, do not wait for the fixed 10:15 PM slot. Persist an exact edition/execution/commit/specification-bound image request and use scripts/build-image-lane-handoff.mjs to re-arm the EXISTING Work task 6ac6cf14a9e88191af48c353b9bc1e11 at the earliest supported time after readiness. Preserve that task's Work conversation and base browser instructions; bind the exact request branch/path/SHA in its prompt, read back the saved task and persist the schedule receipt. Respect the one-hour minimum between invocations and never overwrite an actively running target. Duplicate verified handoffs are no-ops. Recovery invocations also repair a missing/unverified handoff before yielding. If D1 remains proof_required, record the activation blocker honestly; scheduling is not quality or activation proof. An explicitly owner-authorized post-publication correction is independent of the original edition's terminal state and original strategy; never mutate that strategy or reopen historical proof attempts. No new schedule, polling loop or worker. Report semantic completion, image acceptance, and live image publication separately.
